name: custtoolset_pillar3_extractor
description: Evaluates User Interface performance, analyzes custom form complexity, and detects UI bloat by correlating custom fields against historical System Notes.

analysisType.description: The specific UI metric to extract. Use 'form_complexity' to map active forms, 'dormant_fields' to identify unused fields via System Notes, or 'ui_latency' to pull Page Time Details.

returns.description: A JSON payload containing DOM latency metrics or an array of unused custom fields classified as UI bloat.
